name: markets
tagline_zh: ESPN赛程撞上Kalshi和Polymarket赔率，一个面板看全。搜球队、比赔率、找套利。
tagline_en: ESPN schedules meet Kalshi & Polymarket odds in one dashboard. Search teams, compare prices, spot.
desc_en: Markets orchestration — connects ESPN live schedules with Kalshi and Polymarket prediction markets. Unified dashboards, odds comparison, entity search, and bet evaluation across platforms. Use when: user wants to see prediction market odds alongside ESPN game schedules, compare odds across platforms, search for a team/player on Kalshi or Polymarket, check for arbitrage between ESPN odds and predic
why_zh: 同类只给单平台数据，它把赛程和预测市场实时对齐，连套利机会都帮你标出来。
why_en: Others show single-platform data; this syncs live schedules with prediction markets and flags arbitrage for you.
